visualCharacteristics: Short full-width photo banner (~210px tall at 1280 wide, 4:1 crop) with dark left-side overlay; white H1 and white subtitle left-aligned at the bottom of the container width
contentPattern: Background photo row, then H1 + subtitle paragraph row

usage.description: Page-title banner at the top of service and program pages: a background photo behind the page H1 and a one-line summary.

reuseGuidance: Use as the first block on a page with a photo banner behind the page title. Either row may be omitted: without an image it renders as a plain title area; without text it renders as a 4:1 photo strip.
